nav.label: Page sections
hero.title: Run your laboratory from registration to verified report — in the cloud.
hero.text: Sky LIS connects reception, the bench, finance and the patient report in one secure, bilingual workspace for every branch of your laboratory.
demo.title: Demo figures
demo.subtitle: Main branch · today
features.title: Everything a laboratory needs
features.subtitle: One platform for the daily work of reception, the bench and the accounts.
feature.registration.title: Registration and payment
feature.registration.text: Patient files, visits with payers, discounts, preparation questions and payment captured in the same screen.
feature.samples.title: Samples and barcodes
feature.samples.text: Tubes grouped by sample type, Code 128 labels, collection and receipt with rejection reasons and a full trail.
feature.results.title: Results and verification
feature.results.text: Entry by accession or worklist, reference ranges by age and sex, delta checks, review and verification, bilingual reports.
feature.catalogue.title: Catalogue and microbiology
feature.catalogue.text: Services, tests with ranges and formulas, sample types, clinical groups and microbiology lists.
feature.finance.title: Finance and treasuries
feature.finance.text: Price lists, payers, receipts and refunds, and treasury access per device.
feature.setup.title: Branches, roles and users
feature.setup.text: Your branches, roles with their privileges, staff accounts and an audit trail of every change.
feature.analysers.title: Analyser integration
feature.analysers.text: ASTM and HL7 analysers through a site agent, test mappings and results that arrive straight to the worklist.
feature.automation.title: Automation
feature.automation.text: Auto-verification rules per clinical group and medical rules that flag what needs a human look.
portals.title: Two portals, one platform
portals.client.title: Client portal — your laboratory
portals.client.text: Everything your staff does every day, branch by branch, with roles and permissions you control.
portals.admin.title: Super Admin portal — National Technology
portals.admin.text: How we run the platform for you: clients and subscriptions, master data, the audit trail and live sessions.
admin.masterData: Global master data copied to every new laboratory
admin.library: Analyser models, PCR kits and code systems
release.title: Release 1 highlights
release.subtitle: What is live in the first release.
release.registration.title: Registration with payment
release.registration.text: Register patients, price from the base price list and the payer, and collect payment before saving.
release.catalogue.title: Catalogue and microbiology
release.catalogue.text: Services, tests, units, sample types, clinical groups and microbiology, copied from the platform library.
release.results.title: Results and worklist
release.results.text: Result entry, review, verification and printing with turnaround tracking.
release.finance.title: Prices, payers and treasuries
release.finance.text: Payers, base price lists, payments and treasury access per device.
release.setup.title: Branches, roles and users
release.setup.text: Your organisation, its branches and the privileges of each role.
release.audit.title: Audit and security
release.audit.text: A tamper-evident trail of every change, sealed credentials and one-time codes.
